title: Edited sensor name will be discarded if the user clicks "OK" on the dialog to close it before first accepting the new text in the editing UI itself
line: A sensor name typed in System Monitor widget settings is now saved by OK or Apply even without pressing Enter or the checkmark first.
explanation: In the Sensors Details page, the label editor (faces/import/Choices.qml) only reported the new label to the page when the edit was confirmed with Enter or the checkmark. Until then the page did not know about the change, so Apply stayed disabled and OK closed the dialog without saving it. The text field now reports the label on every edit, so the dialog becomes dirty and OK/Apply save it; Enter and the checkmark just close the editor.

commits.message:
faces: Store a sensor label while it is being typed

A new sensor label was only stored when the edit was confirmed with
Enter or the check button, so OK or Apply with the editor still open
lost it. Store the label while it is typed; confirming only closes it.

BUG: 467193

patches.diff:
From fae5b2141735f7ece78e9a4065c0b054c692cc79 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:06:40 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] faces: Store a sensor label while it is being typed

A new sensor label was only stored when the edit was confirmed with
Enter or the check button, so OK or Apply with the editor still open
lost it. Store the label while it is typed; confirming only closes it.

BUG: 467193
---
 faces/import/Choices.qml | 17 ++++++++---------
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+), 9 deletions(-)

diff --git a/faces/import/Choices.qml b/faces/import/Choices.qml
index 18988393..bf80ce08 100644
--- a/faces/import/Choices.qml
+++ b/faces/import/Choices.qml
@@ -267,16 +267,15 @@ Control {
                                 TextField {
                                     id: textField
                                     Layout.fillWidth: true
-                                    text: label.text
-                                    cursorPosition: 0
-                                    focus: true
-                                    onAccepted: {
-                                        if (text == sensor.name) {
-                                            text = ""
-                                        }
-                                        sensorLabelChanged(sensor.sensorId, text)
-                                        layout.state = ""
+                                    Component.onCompleted: {
+                                        text = label.text
+                                        cursorPosition = 0
                                     }
+                                    focus: true
+                                    // Store the label as it is typed, so OK and Apply save it
+                                    // even if the edit was never confirmed.
+                                    onTextEdited: control.sensorLabelChanged(sensor.sensorId, text == sensor.name ? "" : text)
+                                    onAccepted: layout.state = ""
                                 }
                                 ToolButton {
                                     icon.name: "checkmark"
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: typing XYZ in the label editor leaves Apply disabled
Master: after OK and reopening, the old name 'Number of CPUs' is back
Fixed: typing XYZ enables Apply right away
Fixed: after OK (no Enter/checkmark) and reopening, the label is XYZ

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in libksysguard's Choices.qml that emits sensorLabelChanged while typing via onTextEdited instead of waiting for onAccepted, so Apply enables immediately and OK saves the new name even without pressing Enter or the checkmark. Initializing text and cursorPosition in Component.onCompleted avoids any binding feedback when clearing the field or resetting to the default sensor name. The before/after screenshots, regression checks (checkmark, Cancel, reset to default name), and autotest run all verify the fix cleanly.
